prioritized_recommendations.recommendation: Smooth the jump between CGI Sun and Earth beach at 0:06.
Lower background track by 3dB during the core temperature explanation.
Add burned-in captions for key statistics like 99.86% mass.

factual_issues.issue: Narration omits rotation speed, focusing on 11-year pole swap instead.
factual_issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief mention of the 27-day rotation during the sunspot visual.

thumbnail_recommendation.description: High-detail close-up of the Sun's surface with glowing solar flares and dark sunspots.

overall_assessment: A polished documentary short with impressive visual fidelity and clear educational value. The narrative flow is logical, though the transition between cosmic scales and terrestrial scenes could be more fluid.
